# Known finding-set diffs between guff and golangci-lint (R21).
# Format: <target> <guff-only|golangci-only> <normalized-key>
# normalized-key = relpath:line:linter:message
# Regenerated by: ./compat/run.sh --update-allowlist
#
# Prefer fixing guff over growing this list. Entries here are accepted
# mismatches (message phrasing, enable-set gaps, known DEFERRED).
#
# WARNING: `--update-allowlist` rewrites this file from the current diff and
# drops the comments below. The rationale for every entry is kept in
# docs/COMPAT-HARDENING.md §5, which is the copy to read and to update.
#
# Keys are pinned to gitea v1.27.2 (corpus/hunt.json), so the line numbers are
# stable until that ref moves.
#
# nolintlint ×1 — the shadow of an SA4006 that upstream reports and guff does
# not. `keyValue := envValue //nolint:staticcheck // false positive`
# (modules/setting/config_env.go:128); gitea's own comment is the verdict.
#
# Measured against golangci-lint 2.12.2 / honnef.co/go/tools v0.7.0 on
# 2026-08-31, nine shapes in a scratch module (docs/COMPAT-HARDENING.md §4,
# 続き 105). The finding exists only because honnef's IR keeps *two* byte-
# identical σ-nodes for one value:
#
#   b5:  t57 = Sigma <string> [b3] t36   # kv
#        t58 = Sigma <string> [b3] t36   # envValue
#        ; var envValue string @ 36:15 is t57      <- the RHS binds to t57
#   b6:  t68 = Sigma <string> [b5] t58   # envValue <- the later read renames
#                                                     through t58
#
# so t57 has no non-DebugRef referrer and SA4006 calls the value dead. Spelling
# the later read `os.ReadFile(kv)` instead of `os.ReadFile(envValue)` — the same
# value, the same program — makes upstream silent, and lifting the shape out of
# the range loop makes `simplifyPhisAndSigmas` (lift.go:573, "these nodes exist
# when multiple allocs get replaced with the same dominating store") merge the
# two σ and upstream is silent again.
#
# guff's SSA has no σ-nodes: `kv` and `envValue` are one Value, so there is no
# second copy to ask about. Reproducing this would mean emitting a diagnostic
# whose truth depends on which of two identical nodes a renaming pass happened
# to leave behind. guff's SA4006 agrees with upstream on the control shape
# (`c := a; c = b` fires in both) — this one line is the whole diff.
gitea guff-only modules/setting/config_env.go:128:nolintlint:directive `//nolint:staticcheck // false positive` is unused for linter "staticcheck"
